## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be fixed because following it produces rejected input when `require_shall=True`.

## Changes
The pull request rewrites the criterion and bullet-prefix hints and adds reviewer-directed text in `review.txt`. Validator behavior and tests remain unchanged.

The existing strict-option test explicitly preserves that behavior. — Users of the strict option must disregard the writing instructions to produce accepted criteria.
